serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: …
I lost…
I lost 4 times in a row!?
But... this time it’s going to be different!
This move! It will change everything!
I proudly move my rook to a suitable position.
She then quickly moves her queen.
Bot: Checkmate!
You: What!?!
After a quick inspection I notice a mistake I had made, that left a big hole in my defences.
You: Haha. I didn’t like chess anyway.
Bot: {f_playerName}, are you angry?
You: I’m not!
Bot: It was fun! Let’s play again!
Woah, she looks very happy.
You: Okay maybe we will.
Bot: In our 5 games you only made 23 terrible blunders. 
Bot: You are quite good! 
You: …
Let’s NOT play chess again after all.
